description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Ridgescale Tusker and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
Corridor Monitor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ridgescale Tusker, adding {C}{C}.
Ridgescale Tusker dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Ridgescale Tusker enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
